articles.headline: Governments are freezing new data centre builds as AI infrastructure strains power and water supplies
articles.summary: Regulators and cities are increasingly restricting or banning new data centre construction because of electricity costs, water use, land scarcity and community pressure. This raises execution risk and capex uncertainty for cloud buyers, AI deployers, and any business planning new infrastructure-dependent workloads.

articles.headline: Apple overhauls EU App Store fees and loosens rules for alternative app stores
articles.summary: Changes to App Store fees and distribution rules can alter customer-acquisition costs, pricing strategy, and app monetization for software vendors. Businesses selling digital products in Europe may need to reassess margins, channel mix, and compliance processes.

articles.headline: Etched’s valuation doubles to $21B as AI-chip investors keep funding alternatives to Nvidia
articles.summary: A rapid valuation jump in an AI-chip startup signals continuing investor appetite for infrastructure that could challenge or complement incumbent accelerators. For businesses tracking AI compute costs, it suggests the market still expects major shifts in hardware supply, pricing, and procurement options.
